name: Necro Roamer

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has two rooftop weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 36 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. These weapon mounts can be equipped with Large or smaller ranged siege weapons.

text: Favored by necromancers, this vehicle is a heavily fortified, armored wooden shed mounted on the legs of a dozen undead creatures.
